map.文本二维码是一款IT 开发领域的在线工具。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，: Text QR Code is an online tool in the IT development space. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.容量（版本 V，纠错 L）：数字最多 7089 字符 @ V40-L: Capacity (version V, EC L): up to 7089 numeric chars @ V40-L
map.结构：定位/校正图形 + 格式信息 + 数据码字 + Reed-Solomon: Structure: finder/alignment patterns + format info + data codewords + Reed-Solomon error correction
map.二维码（QR Code）按版本（V1–V40，边长 21+4(V−1) 模块）承: A QR Code carries data by version (V1–V40, side length 21+4(V−1) modules); capacity varies with version and error-correction level: at V40-L it holds up to about 7089 numeric characters or 2953 bytes. The encoding flow: data is converted per mode (numeric/alphanumeric/byte/CJK) into a bitstream → segmented to fill capacity → Reed-Solomon generates error-correction codewords (levels L/M/Q/H recover about 7%/15%/25%/30% of codewords respectively) → interleaved and placed into the matrix per rules, applying the lowest-penalty of 8 masks. Longer text and higher EC level mean denser modules; keep the printed size at least 2×2 cm.
map.分享。: QR code from a piece of text to share.
map.把一段说明文字或口令做成二维码贴在设备上，需要时用手机扫码即可获取，免去手抄。: Turn an instruction or password into a QR code stuck on a device; scan with a phone when needed, avoiding manual copying.
map.能，UTF-8 编码后入码。: Yes, encoded as UTF-8 before entering the code.
map.中文内容为什么更容易扫不出来？: Why are Chinese contents harder to scan?
map.因为汉字在二维码中按字节模式编码时每个字占 3 字节（UTF-8），比字母数字模: Because each Chinese character occupies 3 bytes (UTF-8) in byte mode, far lower density than alphanumeric mode, so the same content uses more codewords, a higher version, and smaller modules. For longer content, use concise copy or store a link instead; also enlarge the print size accordingly.
